title: Wildlife
description: Quiet pauses, bright colours, and small encounters among the leaves.

DSCF5425.jpg.title: Among the branches
DSCF5425.jpg.caption: A quiet pause in the canopy.
DSCF5425.jpg.alt: A grey monkey with a pale face and reddish legs sitting among branching trees and green leaves.

DSCF5491.jpg.title: Electric blue
DSCF5491.jpg.caption: A flash of blue in a world of green.
DSCF5491.jpg.alt: An iridescent blue bird with a bright yellow eye perched on a thin branch against green foliage.

DSCF5538.jpg.title: Through the leaves
DSCF5538.jpg.caption: Just enough of a glimpse to make you stop.
DSCF5538.jpg.alt: An orange-and-black patterned bird peering through overlapping green leaves, with its head and part of its chest visible.

DSCF5547.jpg.title: Resting lines
DSCF5547.jpg.caption: Stripes, soft light, and nowhere to be.
DSCF5547.jpg.alt: A duck with a long blue-grey bill and fine black-and-white striped plumage resting on a mossy log.

DSCF5573.jpg.title: Making an entrance
DSCF5573.jpg.caption: One stretch of the wings, with a bright red backdrop.
DSCF5573.jpg.alt: A brown wading bird spreading its wings in shallow water, with several vivid red birds behind it.
